name: Mosque of the Andalusians
scope: The Mosque of the Andalusians in Fez as documented in April 2016. Model the named mosque envelope, open courtyard and fountain, prayer hall roofscape, minaret and monumental northern entrance. Adjacent neighborhood buildings are outside the scope.

originalReview.notes: The exact April 2016 street view fixes the horseshoe entrance arch, ivory surround, patterned tile spandrels, dark multipart wooden gate and carved cedar canopy.

review.method: Exact Qualla original and named native public-domain release
review.notes: The exact published Qualla original matches the Commons upload byte for byte. Mx. Granger is the uploader and named author and placed the own work under CC0.
